item.title: Dominion offshore wind project cost rises to $11.5B after stop work order, tariffs
item.description: Dominion Energy reported in a Friday regulatory filing that the cost of the Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind project has increased to $11.5 billion due to tariffs and a stop work order issued in December by the federal government.

item.title: Man found guilty of murdering 19-year-old at behest of jailed friend in Chesapeake
item.description: Seth Morgan, 37, was found guilty by a jury on Friday in the July 2020 murder of Antonio San Antonio. Morgan, who testified at his own trial to a scheme to defraud the government, shot and killed the 19-year-old at the direction of a friend in jail, William Whittaker.

item.title: Hampton Roads weekend closings, cancellations
item.description: Due to forecasted winter weather, some facilities have announced closures and delays over the weekend.

item.title: Chesapeake resident portrays Continental Army chaplain during Revolution
item.description: Historical interpreter Tim Platek of Chesapeake understands the influences — political and social changes — that can affect the course of human life and survival in the struggle along life’s path.

item.title: Top-ranked Landstown holds off No. 15 Salem in Beach District showdown
item.description: A strong fourth quarter enabled the Eagles to pull away from the host SunDevils, who honored their 2001 state champs.

item.title: Photos: Landstown beats Salem
item.description: The Landstown Eagles beat the Salem Sundevils 68-57 at Salem High School in Virginia Beach, Virginia, on January 30, 2026.

item.title: Hampton University women halt skid at 3 with win at UNC Wilmington
item.description: Aisha Dabo and Kayla Lezama combined for 30 HU points in a CAA victory. The William & Mary women lost, though.

item.title: Admirals break out in first period, begin series by ending 2-game slide
item.description: Kevin Conley scored twice as Norfolk won the opener of a two-game series at Scope. The Admirals will close a seven-game homestand Saturday night.

item.title: ODU women let late lead get away, fall in OT at home to Southern Miss
item.description: After ODU led by 17 in the third quarter, Southern Miss came back. Jakayla Johnson dropped in a game-high 32 points for the visitors as the Monarchs suffered an uncommon home defeat.

item.title: High school scoreboard: Princess Anne boys basketball team overcomes No. 5 Green Run
item.description: No. 10 Deep Creek were led in a 39-26 girls basketball victory over No. 12 Grassfield by Cherish Brehon with 13 points.
